SB 16 (2025), requires proof of citizenship to register to vote, with a limited federal ballot for those who cannot supply it. The Texas Legislature Online page lists this member among the House cosponsors; page shows House committee report sent to Calendars 05/25/2025.
HB 4253 (2025), by another member, on confirmation of a voter's residence by a voter registrar. The page lists him among the coauthors; last action 05/05/2025, committee report sent to Calendars.
